systems.notes: PMA line "MFR-EV" (eTransit line 73) has 11 routes. Launched 17 Sep 2026 with 45 buses in phase 1. Most MFR-EV routes are electric versions of the diesel MFR feeder routes (same terminals, slightly different stop lists), but they are separate services with separate eTransit route ids, so they are kept in this system and not in multan-feeder. Route ids are "MFR-EV-<eTransit route id>" because PMA publishes no printed route number; EV-VC-NC keeps its existing id.

open_questions: Private wagon/Hiace/Qingqi routes with ordered stops: none found online for Multan, Sialkot, Gujranwala (B1/B2/B4/B5 intermediates), Bahawalpur, Rahim Yar Khan, Dera Ghazi Khan, Sheikhupura, Kasur or Okara. The only sources are district RTA route-permit registers, which are not published.
PCIIP corridors (Sargodha, Sahiwal, Gujrat, Jhang) date from c.2010 and are Qingqi/rickshaw corridors, not numbered routes. They should be verified on the ground before being shown to riders.

Coordinates taken from PMA eTransit (coord_source "ext:etransit.punjab.gov.pk:stop/<id>") are official agency data, but SCHEMA.md allows only OSM or Wikipedia coordinates. The owner should decide whether to keep them (data/systems already contains "ext:safar.fyi" coordinates) or null them and let the pipeline geocode.
Reuse terms for the eTransit Punjab API are not stated. sources-apis.md lists PMA as a contact for reuse permission.
Routes with merge_action "replace_existing" update routes that already exist (same id). Merge them by replacing the existing route, not by appending.
Gujranwala city e-buses (12 buses, due end-July 2026) do not appear in eTransit yet, as of 2026-09-24.
